questions.question: Which of the following is the SI-derived unit for measuring electric conductance?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Siemens**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Siemens** is the SI unit for measuring electric conductance.
 
• **Siemens per unit is the unit of electrical conductivity**.
 
• **Mho** is also known as siemens.
 
• The reciprocal of o**hm is siemens**.
 
• The reciprocal of resistance is** siemens.**
 
• In the 14th general conference on weights and measures, the unit of conductance known as siemens was adopted.
 
• The unit was named after Earner won Siemens.
 
• The ratio of current **density to the electric field strength gives the value of electrical conductivity.**
 
• If the conductivity of a substance is higher, then the resistance of that substance will be lower and the flow of electric current will be smoother.
 
• The** ability of electrons or charge carriers decides the value of electrical conductivity.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **H****enry**** **is the SI-derived unit of electrical inductance**.**
 
• ** Farad** is the SI-derived unit of electrical capacitance.
 
• Tesla is a unit of the magnetic induction.

questions.question: Which Article of the Constitution of India directs the State to take steps to separate the judiciary from the executive in the public services of the State?
